topStories.headline: July Jobs Report Disappoints; September Fed Rate Cut Odds Climb
topStories.summary: The BLS July Employment Situation report is due at 8:30 AM ET; ADP private payrolls pre-printed only 44K new jobs for July vs. 75K consensus, signalling another below-expectations print after June's weak 57K; the Fed held rates at 3.50–3.75% in a divided 9–3 vote on July 29.
topStories.marketImpact: ↑ September rate cut probability; ↓ US dollar (DXY); ↑ Treasuries (TLT); S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures mixed ahead of open

topStories.headline: Palantir Q2 Revenue Surges 93%; US Commercial AI Revenue Up 149%
topStories.summary: Palantir posted Q2 revenue of $1.94B (+93% YoY), GAAP EPS of $0.41, and raised full-year revenue guidance to $8.15–8.16B (representing ~82% YoY growth), driven by explosive adoption of its AI platforms across US commercial and government clients.
topStories.marketImpact: PLTR ↑ ~15% post-earnings; AI software sector broadly ↑; SMH semiconductor ETF rallied in sympathy

topStories.headline: Amazon Crosses $3 Trillion Market Cap; Bezos Sells $4B in Pre-Planned Share Trade
topStories.summary: Amazon became the fourth company to reach a $3 trillion valuation after strong AWS earnings (+37% YoY); founder Jeff Bezos subsequently sold 15M shares ($4.07B) via a pre-set 10b5-1 plan, dragging shares ~2% in a move described as a 'buzzkill' by Jim Cramer.
topStories.marketImpact: AMZN ↓ ~2% on Bezos sale overhang despite strong AWS growth; $3T market cap in focus as support floor

topStories.headline: Apple Beats Q3 but Q4 Guidance Misses Analyst Estimates; Stock Falls 6%
topStories.summary: Apple reported record June quarter revenue of $109.4B (+16% YoY), EPS of $1.91 vs. $1.89 estimated, but guided Q4 revenue growth at 9–11%, falling short of the ~12% analyst consensus due to Mac supply constraints and a 2.5ppt FX headwind.
topStories.marketImpact: AAPL ↓ ~6% in extended trading; Nasdaq weighed on tech sentiment; services revenue at a record $30.7B remains a structural positive

topStories.headline: Honeywell Aerospace Crashes 20% After Slashing 2026 Sales Growth Outlook
topStories.summary: Honeywell Aerospace Technologies cut its 2026 organic sales growth guidance to 4–5%, sharply down from its prior 7–9% forecast, citing slower defense procurement cycles, supply chain delays, and weaker-than-expected commercial aviation demand.
topStories.marketImpact: HONA ↓ ~20%; defense and industrial sector broadly under pressure; contagion risk for other aerospace suppliers

topStories.headline: Hong Kong Raises 2026 GDP Forecast; IPO Market Tops Full-Year 2025 in Seven Months
topStories.summary: Financial Secretary Paul Chan signalled Hong Kong will upgrade its 2026 full-year GDP forecast after H1 GDP rose 5.1% YoY; IPO proceeds through July surpassed all of 2025 by 13%; the city launched offshore China Government Bond Futures on August 3, reinforcing its role as a financial hub.
topStories.marketImpact: HSI ↑ 0.5% to 26,009; ↑ HK-listed tech and financials; positive sentiment for Chinese ADRs and mainland capital markets

topStories.headline: Nikkei Falls 0.93% as Japan Chip and Electronics Stocks Face Broad Selloff
topStories.summary: The Nikkei 225 closed at 65,683 (–0.93% Thursday), led lower by Japan's semiconductor and passive component makers — Kioxia Holdings –10.2%, Taiyo Yuden –11%, Murata Manufacturing –5.2%, and SoftBank Group –4.4% — while Nintendo bucked the trend on US tariff refunds and strong Switch 2 sales.
topStories.marketImpact: 285A.T ↓ 10.2%, 6981.T ↓ 5.2%, 9984.T ↓ 4.4%; global chip supply chain anxiety resurfaces; BoJ holds at 1.0% but September hike remains on the table

topStories.headline: Oil Retreats to $85 WTI as Trump Signals Iran Deal Framework, Hormuz Partially Reopens
topStories.summary: WTI crude pulled back toward $85/bbl (Brent ~$90) as President Trump signalled a potential deal framework and partial Strait of Hormuz reopening; Iranian tanker attacks in late July had previously spiked Brent above $114/bbl, representing a dramatic reversal from the peak crisis premium.
topStories.marketImpact: Energy sector ↑ on short-covering relief; ↓ oil inflation premium eases broader CPI trajectory; watch for any resumption of Iranian tanker attacks

topStories.headline: US Slaps New 12.5% Tariffs on China; Trade Talks Penciled for Late August
topStories.summary: The US imposed new 12.5% Section 301 tariffs on Chinese goods effective July 24; China is sending Vice Commerce Minister Wang Shouwen to resume negotiations in late August, but a new round of tit-for-tat tariffs targeting $16B of goods from each country is expected August 23 if talks fail.
topStories.marketImpact: ↓ China-exposed US retailers and manufacturers; ↑ uncertainty for Chinese exporters; BABA, JD and HK-listed names watching diplomatic progress closely
